assumptions.statement: Official boundary, parcel and ownership, road redlines, utilities, heritage controls and approved planning controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All geometry remains a non-statutory design discussion and must be replaced or recalculated before approval or engineering use.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons are repository provisional approximations, including the rough placement of Dazhongsi.
assumptions.impact: No polygon edge is interpreted as a parcel or road boundary; official polygons trigger full-package recalculation.

assumptions.statement: No verified building inventory, condition survey, ownership or occupancy dataset is used.
assumptions.impact: Building envelopes are prototypes; retain, renovate and remove decisions are explicitly pending.

assumptions.statement: No field counts, accessibility audit, curb survey, signal plan or station-interface drawing is available.
assumptions.impact: Mobility lines describe service logic, not existing or approved alignments.

assumptions.statement: Drainage, flood, power, telecom, fire, soil and heat-source data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Rainwater, edge-compute and heat-reuse ideas require separate engineering pilots and metering.

assumptions.statement: Operators, service hours, staffing, maintenance, insurance and escalation chains are not contracted.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards are procurement requirements, not claims of an operating service.

assumptions.statement: Verified quantities, unit rates, funding sources and procurement packages are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: CAPEX and OPEX remain unknown; each phase is controlled by a cost-and-owner gate.

assumptions.statement: No resident, worker, child, caregiver, disability or business group has endorsed this AI-generated proposal.
assumptions.impact: Personas are design prompts only and must be replaced by consent-based participation evidence.

assumptions.statement: Scenario-specific data protection impact assessments, retention schedules and appeal procedures are not approved.
assumptions.impact: No personal tracking is authorized; low-risk pilots require independent review and a non-digital route.

assumptions.statement: Exact heritage protection scope, archaeological requirements and view controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The heritage proof line is narrative and spatially abstract, never an exact control line.
